scheme.name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
scheme.disbursement: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to consumer bank account post-commissioning

residential.eligibility: Individual residential household with domestic electricity connection

ghs.note: Group Housing Society / Resident Welfare Association — common facilities

stateTopUp.note: Kerala provides no additional state subsidy. Central CFA only.

dcr.note: DCR (Domestic Content Requirement) modules mandatory for subsidy eligibility. Solar cells must be manufactured in India from undiffused silicon wafer (Black Wafer).
dcr.almmListI: Solar PV Modules — mandatory since March 2021
dcr.almmListII: Solar PV Cells — mandatory since June 2026
dcr.giveItUpNote: Consumer may forgo subsidy and use non-DCR panels. Retains net metering benefits. Choice is irreversible.
